Crikey! It's The Irwins S3E4 -A Baby Giraffe's Tall Order
programme.desc: After the birth of Talbert the giraffe, complications arise and the Irwins worry for his life. Robert rescues an entangled black swan caught in fishing line.

programme.title: 第4集 - 長頸鹿寶寶有難
programme.desc: 母長頸鹿蘿西經過15個月的孕期即將產下牠的第四個小寶寶, 也是頭一個男寶寶托伯特。大家興奮又期待地為蘿西準備舒適的產房, 見證托伯特出生的一刻。但是托伯特一出生就有異狀, 牠花了比正常超出一個鐘頭的時間才能站立, 而且前肢過度伸展。讓人驚喜的是, 兩個星期後牠自己痊癒了, 成為一隻特別優雅的長頸鹿。南方白犀牛金斯頓即將滿一周歲, 賓蒂與錢德勒負責幫牠準備生日禮物和辦生日趴, 慶祝這個重大里程碑。羅伯特接獲通知去救援一隻被釣線纏住、被釣鉤鉤住腳的黑天鵝厄文, 原本狀似危急但極度幸運的厄文沒有傷到要害, 在野生動物醫院觀察一夜後重返野地。

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side S1E2
programme.desc: This pure wildlife docuseries travels from Hokkaido's vast forests to the lush coastlines of Okinawa.

programme.title: 第2集
programme.desc: 溫暖的天氣跟延長的白晝, 帶來喘息與蛻變, 這是展開新氣象的時機, 事前準備跟抓準時機很重要, 才能好好迎接日本野生大地上的繁殖競賽。

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That? S1E34 -Lizard Vs Water Buffalo
programme.desc: How can a fish fly the length of three football fields? Can a spider be adorable? What's the real story behind a flamingo's colour?

programme.title: 第34集 - 可愛蜘蛛
programme.desc: 外型搶眼的紅鸛剛出生時全身都是白色的, 過了一陣子竟然還會變成灰色?牠們又是怎麼變成粉紅色, 且看節目解密。

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That? S1E35 -Now Thats A Smart Fish
programme.desc: How is one fish blowing scientists away with its brainpower? How have dogs learnt to melt our hearts? Do chimps laugh at the same jokes we do?

programme.title: 第35集 - 大眼狗兒
programme.desc: 狗狗大大的雙眼令人難以抗拒, 但科學家發現狗狗竟然只會對人類露出這種表情。奇妙的鴨嘴獸是一種神奇的物種, 而且竟然曾和恐龍同時生存在地球上!

programme.title: Vantara: Sanctuary Stories S1E5 -Habitats For The Future
programme.desc: Forrest visits Vantara, joins a cheetah feeding circle, sees the growth of a sun bear called Prince, and how Vantara safeguards endangered species.

programme.title: 第5集 - 未來棲地
programme.desc: 佛瑞斯特造訪萬塔拉, 加入獵豹餵食圈, 見證一隻名叫王子的馬來熊成長歷程, 也了解萬塔拉如何守護瀕危物種。

programme.title: Little Giants S1E10 -Rainforest Ninja
programme.desc: In the Madagascan rainforest, the team searches for a nearly invisible creature: the panther chameleon.

programme.title: 第10集 - 無聲無息
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼, 但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是馬達加斯加雨林裡的豹紋變色龍。牠是非常成功的掠食者, 可以完美融入環境當中, 即使就在你面前, 也不容易發現。此外, 豹紋變色龍的眼睛還能獨立旋轉, 任何東西都逃不過牠的全能之眼；舌頭擊發的攻擊力道和速度更是驚人, 威力簡直和建築工地的落錘有得比。

programme.title: Coyote Peterson: Brave The Wild S1E6 -Constricted By A Colossal Python
programme.desc: As night falls on the arid Outback, Coyote and his crew set out in search of the continent's non-venomous snake group, pythons.

programme.title: 第6集 - 纏人大蟒蛇
programme.desc: 卡悠提前往澳洲, 找尋令人生懼的大蟒蛇。

programme.title: My Cat From Hell S5E17 -Hell-Iday Special
programme.desc: Jackson tries to save the holidays for three Boston families. A Bengal threatens to ruin a couple's first holiday.

programme.title: 第17集 - 佳節變調
programme.desc: 這集的「管教惡貓」是聖誕特輯。主持人傑克森到波士頓拜訪三個家庭, 三家人的共通點就是他們都有惡貓, 而且飼主之一都想把貓咪送到收容所。第一隻貓是尼爾森和梅麗莎養的歐利, 歐利喜歡亂撒尿, 而且多數都尿在男主人的東西上。第二對夫妻大衛和珍妮養了兩隻貓史丹利和雪比, 兩隻貓一見面就打架, 他們根本無法請朋友到家裡作客。第三對夫妻是剛生了兒子亞尼的比利和柯妮, 他們的豹貓芬恩調皮搗蛋, 柯妮很擔心貓咪傷害小兒子。傑克森再度拿出看家本領, 拯救三個家庭與這些惡貓。

programme.desc: Opening the borders of Myanmar provides an opportunity for Nathanael to discover new reptile and amphibian species.

programme.title: 第3集 - 眼鏡蛇王
programme.desc: 緬甸乾燥的蒲甘平原是爬蟲學家納森尼爾這次旅程的起點。這座平原上有三千多座寺廟, 納森尼爾在這裡抓到了俗稱「飛蛇」的美麗金花蛇, 還有俗稱「軟殼龜」的緬甸箱鱉。接著他到博彬區, 找到了世界第二大的蜥蜴: 澤巨蜥。最後他在竹林裡遇到世界上最毒的蛇類, 眼鏡王蛇, 為百科全書資料收集之旅畫上完美的句點。

programme.title: Saving Britain's Wildlife S1E9 -Time Heals Everything
programme.desc: En-route to a rescue Brian Milligan spots another emergency situation as a Canada Goose is about to step out into busy traffic, he must intervene to avoid accident.

programme.desc: 亞斯塔與諾艾兒為了稟報任務結果, 前往騎士團總部所在的王貴界。兩人與在中途遇見的尤諾、克勞斯、米莫薩一同前行。現任魔法帝尤利烏斯將亞斯塔一行人視為特別嘉賓親自接見, 並邀請他們參加戰功授勳儀式。眾人在那裡見到獲得無數星星的魔法騎士團菁英成員。

programme.title: 第21集 - Royal Capital Riot
programme.desc: 亞斯塔對因為看不起他們而說三道四的魔法騎士團團員感到惱怒, 並在險惡的氣氛下爆發衝突。紅蓮獅子王團的團長費根雷翁出面阻止紛爭, 卻遭到銀翼大鷲團的團長, 同時也是諾艾兒哥哥的諾傑爾反駁。眼看局勢一觸即發, 此時傳來王都遭到某人襲擊的通報!

programme.desc: 400 years ago, Tinasha destroyed Tuldarr in a single night. Oscar rewrote history, erasing the Witch of the Azure Moon.

programme.title: 第23集 - At Memory's End
programme.desc: 瑪葛達魯西亞和鐸洱達爾終於開戰。當緹娜夏對上露琪亞, 奧斯卡趕來傳達瓦爾托提供的情報。露琪亞體內的是瑪葛達魯西亞的國王, 露克芮札的靈魂則被關在「忘卻之鏡」中。將露琪亞交給奧斯卡對付, 緹娜夏則去破壞「忘卻之鏡」, 但這場戰鬥的終結不過是段插曲。

programme.desc: 400 years ago, Tinasha destroyed Tuldarr in a single night. Oscar rewrote history, erasing the Witch of the Azure Moon.

programme.title: 第24集 - Death Of The Nameless Story
programme.desc: 瓦爾托為了避免摯愛, 蜜菈莉絲的靈魂因歷史走到盡頭而被解體, 拿鐸洱達爾當籌碼逼緹娜夏破壞艾爾特利亞。緹娜夏雖明白魔法球為瓦爾托帶來的痛苦和其影響力, 仍感到猶豫不已。她將後事託付給奧斯卡後抱著藍色魔法球跳入無言之湖, 並回到她最幸福的那一刻...

programme.title: D.Gray-Man S1E47 -The Girl Of The Crystal
programme.desc: Exorcists discover Mei Ling and a crystal ball that may be causing a water shortage. They search for the possible Innocence against level 2 Akumas.

programme.title: 第47集 - The Girl Of The Crystal
programme.desc: 亞連終於和分離的夥伴們會合, 抵達中國麗江。不過當地卻遭逢異常的缺水現象。亞連和利娜莉在城裡收集情報, 拉比等人則分頭前往水源調查。利娜莉和亞連來到由少女梅琳和祖父共同經營的商店, 據說這名少女能用水晶球預知未來, 緊追不捨的惡魔卻再度現身。

programme.title: D.Gray-Man S1E48 -Wavering Accommodator
programme.desc: The Exorcists save Mei Ling from the Akuma. She finally accepts her destiny as an exorcist after learning more about them.

programme.title: 第48集 - Wavering Accommodator
programme.desc: 亞連和利娜莉前去尋找被惡魔帶走的梅琳。另一邊, 書人從梅琳的祖父那裡聽聞關於她的故事。據他所說, 擁有以水晶球預知未來能力的梅琳不時會受惡夢所苦。隨著作夢頻率變頻繁、夢境內容越發糟糕, 心疼可憐孫女的祖父決定採取行動, 梅琳與水源之謎也將揭曉!

programme.title: Why Raeliana Ended Up At The Duke's Mansion S1E6 -Why Raeliana Cosplayed
programme.desc: Raeliana wakes up in Noah's bed and sees him naked. She runs away and disguises herself as a maid in the mansion.

programme.title: 第6集 - Why Raeliana Cosplayed
programme.desc: 萊利娜不小心在努爾的馬上睡著了。當她在隔天早上醒來時, 發現自己睡在努爾的臥房, 旁邊還躺著赤裸著上半身的他。萊利娜在情急之下拜託亞當幫她逃離此處。被留在房間的努爾命令執事長奇德翁動員所有騎士搜尋兩人, 但萊利娜早已為了躲避搜索而假扮成女僕。

programme.title: Why Raeliana Ended Up At The Duke's Mansion S1E7 -Why Raeliana Handed Her A Handkerchief
programme.desc: It's a custom for women to give men a handkerchief before a Monster Hunt. Noah makes a request to Raeliana on that day.

programme.title: 第7集 - Why Raeliana Handed Her A Handkerchief
programme.desc: 萊利娜收到了弗麗絲答應給她的, 於錫克雷特山脈召開的魔物討伐戰邀請函。依照討伐戰慣例, 女性將贈送手帕給男性, 男性則會將捕捉到的魔物獻給女性。努爾之前從未收下任何人的手帕, 也從未獻上魔物給任何人。到了討伐戰當日, 努爾對萊利娜提出了某項要求。

programme.title: Black Clover S1E20 -Assembly At The Royal Capital

programme.title: 第20集 - Assembly At The Royal Capital
programme.desc: 亞斯塔與諾艾兒為了稟報任務結果, 前往騎士團總部所在的王貴界。兩人與在中途遇見的尤諾、克勞斯、米莫薩一同前行。現任魔法帝尤利烏斯將亞斯塔一行人視為特別嘉賓親自接見, 並邀請他們參加戰功授勳儀式。眾人在那裡見到獲得無數星星的魔法騎士團菁英成員。

programme.title: Donal Skehan: Home Cook S1E4
programme.desc: Donal shares more delicious dishes; speedy teriyaki salmon with fluffy rice and greens, comforting herby sausage meatballs with pasta and golden oven baked chicken shawarma flatbreads.

programme.title: 第4集
programme.desc: 多諾分享了更多美味料理: 快速製作的照燒鮭魚配上鬆軟的米飯和蔬菜、療癒人心的香草香腸肉丸佐義大利麵和黃金爐烤雞肉沙威瑪麵餅。

programme.title: Junior Bake Off S9E9
programme.desc: It's Pastry Day and the second heat of bakers take on an invisible filling pie challenge and, in the Showstopper, the bakers pay homage to their idols.

programme.title: 第9集
programme.desc: 糕餅日到來, 第二輪預賽的烘焙師接受隱形餡料派的挑戰, 並在精采挑戰中向他們的偶像致意。

programme.title: Hemsley + Hemsley - Healthy And Delicious S1E8 -Party
programme.desc: Jasmine and Melissa show when throwing a party nutrition doesn't have to take a back seat.

programme.title: 第8集 - 派對食物
programme.desc: 潔絲敏與梅莉莎告訴大家舉辦派對時如何營養不倒退

programme.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen S1E2 -Noodles
programme.desc: This episode is all about Asian noodles - from rice and wheat to egg and starch, noodles come in endless shapes, textures, and flavours, making them the perfect match for almost any dish.

programme.title: 第2集 - 麵食
programme.desc: 這一集要來探索亞洲的麵食, 從米、小麥, 到雞蛋與各式澱粉製成的麵條, 形狀、口感與風味千變萬化, 幾乎能搭配任何料理。

programme.title: Donal's Feasts: Fasts And Festivals S1E2
programme.desc: In episode two, Donal joins a Muslim family who are fasting during Ramadan, explores the traditions of the Romanian Orthodox Community as he prepares a traditional Easter meal and joins in the joyous atmosphere of Diwali, the Festival of Lights, as he celebrates and feasts with a Hindu family in their home.

programme.title: 第2集
programme.desc: 在第二集中, 多諾將與一個穆斯林家庭一起度過齋戒月, 探索羅馬尼亞東正教社群的傳統, 並準備一頓傳統的復活節餐點。他還會和一個印度教家庭一起在家中享用美食, 慶祝歡快的光明節。

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee S9E2
programme.desc: The sewers face three challenges inspired by travel. They are asked to create a rucksack, a swimsuit and to transform windbreakers.

programme.title: 第2集
programme.desc: 裁縫師們面對三項旅遊相關的挑戰。他們被要求製作一個後背包、一套泳裝, 並且改造防風外套。

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces S13E5
programme.desc: A life changing camper van for a tetraplegic mum and her son, with cerebral palsy, a deliciously clever build inspired by a cupcake and George visits three eco builds and Portugal's thinnest house.

programme.title: 第5集
programme.desc: 為一位四肢癱瘓的媽媽與腦性麻痺的兒子打造的改變人生的露營車；一個以杯子蛋糕為靈感的絕妙建築；喬治造訪三座環保建築, 以及葡萄牙最窄的房子。

programme.title: Bake Off: The Professionals S8E3
programme.desc: The teams create savoury pate en croute, modern religieuse, and a glamorous wedding mille-feuille showpiece. But who will flake under the pressure and be leaving in tiers?

programme.title: 第3集
programme.desc: 參賽隊伍製作鹹味法式酥皮肉派、現代版修女泡芙塔以及華麗的婚禮千層派代表性糕點。究竟誰會在壓力下崩潰, 流淚離開比賽?

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Food Stars: Australia S1E9
programme.desc: It's the Grand Final and the four remaining foodstars go back to their routes by repatching their products to Janine and Gordon, with the hope of winning $250,000 dollars and a years mentorship.

programme.title: 第9集
programme.desc: 總決賽開始, 最終的四位參賽者將回到根本, 重新調整他們的產品並向珍妮和戈登展示, 希望能贏得25萬美元及一年的指導機會。

programme.title: National Heritage Pilgrimage De O E6
Jang Youngsil: The Greatest Scientist Of Joseon E17
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: 第17集
programme.desc: 是一檔長篇歷史科學劇。本劇講述了天資聰明的蔣英實, 如何以奴婢的身份克服當時的傳統思想與身份等級制度, 成為十五世紀朝鮮時代最有成就的科學家的故事。通過介紹他執著于科學研究事業的一生和所造就的偉大科學業績, 給現在的青年們樹立一個好的榜樣。同時, 本劇將以最先進的科學資料及視頻技術等, 幫助觀眾更容易、更清楚地理解科學原理, 從而引起觀眾的興趣。

programme.desc: 艾瑪白日裡是一位乖巧守禮的阿米希女孩, 過著按部就班、恪守教義的生活；但到了夜晚, 她與好友暗中離開社區, 投身一個截然不同的祕密世界。直到某夜親眼目睹一場駭人的謀殺案, 她平靜的日常以及整個社群的安寧就此被打破。

programme.title: Masterchef Australia S18E19
programme.desc: The cooks responsible for the four bottom dishes in last night's invention must now face the possibility of Rosheen Kaul's Pressure Test today being their last cook in the MasterChef kitchen.

programme.title: 第19集
programme.desc: 在昨晚的創新中, 負責四道最低分菜餚的廚師們現在必須面對羅辛•考爾 (Rosheen Kaul) 今天的壓力測試可能成為他們在《澳洲頂級廚師》廚房中的最後一次烹飪的可能性。

programme.title: Little Angel S2E1 -Baby John's Big Family Adventures!
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big family adventures! First, the family goes on vacation & experiences the excitement of taking a plane for the first time, while also learning some good manners. Then, they are off to the aquarium to see all kinds of sea creatures, like seahorses, jellyfish & an octopus! The adventures continue with a trip to the jungle park to see birds & monkeys, & a super fun day at the fair!

programme.title: Little Angel S6E4 -Important Lessons with Baby John!
programme.desc: Baby John is learning some very important lessons! First, he refuses to try his veggies & fruits, but Mom finds different ways to convince him after she sees that he'll try them if the other members of the family do it first! Then, Mom helps Baby John get through his morning routine with a fun chart. The important lessons continue as Baby John learns about fire safety with a firefighter & how to stay safe during bathtime.

programme.title: CoComelon S2E5 -Let's Make, Play & Learn with JJ!
programme.desc: Get ready to make, play & learn with JJ! First, find out what JJ's favorite pizza toppings are as you sing along to this yummy adventure. Then, Dad shows JJ how to make a healthy & delicious snack: fresh fruit ice cream! The hands-on fun continues as TomTom shows JJ how to be a 'toy mechanic' & fix his favorite toy school bus when a wheel pops off. From learning about veggies to becoming 'Clean Machines,' it's a day of creative fun!

programme.title: CoComelon S2E4 -Let's Play & Learn Outside with JJ!
programme.desc: It's time to play & learn outside with JJ! First, JJ & Cody spend the day taking care of their pets Bingo, Pickles & Jellybean. Then, it's time for a trip to Grandpa's farm to learn about all the animals & the sounds they make! The outdoor fun continues at the park, where JJ discovers tadpoles & learns he'll grow big one day too. The day ends with an exciting soccer match where the kids challenge their parents to a game!

programme.title: CoComelon S5E2 -JJ's Ultimate Pretend Play Day!
programme.desc: It's the ultimate pretend play day with JJ! When the cookies go missing, it's up to Detective JJ & his sidekick Bingo to follow the clues & solve the case. Then, when JJ gets nervous on his first carousel ride, Mom helps him unlock his imagination & he becomes a brave knight on a valiant steed! The pretend play continues as Captain JJ & first mate YoYo set sail on the high seas to find a lost sock. From playing chef to being a Turtle Scout, you can be anything!

programme.title: CoComelon S1E8 -JJ's Nature Walk & Favorite Rhymes!
programme.desc: Join JJ for a nature walk & some of his favorite rhymes! First, JJ's family shows him all the fun things we can do to help the Earth, like sorting trash for recycling. Then, the kids go on a nature walk with Bingo, collecting fun information in their scrapbooks! After the outdoor fun, it's time for classic rhymes. Sing along as ten animal friends try to share a bed & help the three little kittens who have lost their mittens!

programme.title: Morphle S1E1 -Taking on the Baddest Baddies in Town!
programme.desc: It's up to Mila & Morphle to take on the baddest baddies in town! The trouble begins when the Bandits use robot versions of Mila & Morphle to cause chaos. Then, the friends discover a Mirror World where they meet Orphle, Morphle's naughty reflection. When Orphle escapes & causes trouble, they have to stop him! The action continues as the Bandits use a zapper to turn animals into giants & team up with Orphle to escape from jail!

programme.title: Morphle S4E2 -A Big Welcome for the New Magic Pets!
programme.desc: Get ready to welcome some new Magic Pets with Mila & Morphle! The adventure begins when they meet Shrubcub, a pet whose power is to make plants grow, causing a huge flowery jungle to bloom in Pet Port! Then, they meet Slushyseal, who can change items into juice pops, but the friends have to stop him when he starts turning all the trees & flowers into frozen treats! From a pet that swaps bodies to one that hypnotizes animals, it's a day full of new & magical friends!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E7 -Let's Squish Things!
programme.desc: Discover the sense of touch with Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers! Explore fun textures like squishy, soft, and slimy. Learn how we use our sense of touch to understand the world around us, one fun squish at a time.

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E13 -Learn About Dinosaurs!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers dig into dinosaur learning, such as teaching dinosaur names, features, and how they hatched from eggs.

programme.title: Minibods S1E6 -Magic, A Blob, A Show & A Bubble!
programme.desc: Join Bubbles for a day of magic, a blob, a show & a bubble! First, Bubbles is excited to watch Pogo's magic show, but her curiosity gets the better of her & she spoils his tricks! Then, she invents a brand new bouncy blob, but it bounces out of control & causes havoc all over the Bodpod! The adventures continue as Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show & tries her best to stop a giant, beautiful bubble from popping.

programme.title: Minibods S1E3 -A Sick Trick, A Spider, A Bump & A Fly!
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a sick trick, a spider, a bump & a fly! First, Jeff is sick, but after he recovers, he misses the attention & pretends he's still unwell! Then, Fuse is woken up by spooky noises in the night & must put on a brave face for Lulu to investigate. His bravery is tested again when he finds a spider in his gym & doesn't know how to get it out. The chaos ends when Pogo can't sleep & has to deal with a very noisy fly!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures S1E1 -High-Flying Fun!
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, & learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok & the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, & discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S2E3 -Fun Nature Discoveries!
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he & D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made & join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science & new friends!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders S1E1 -An Ultimate Animal Adventure!
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi & his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts & how ducks float. Blippi & FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: CoComelon S3E7 -JJ's Birthday Celebration
programme.desc: It's the night before JJ's birthday and he is too excited to sleep! Join the fun with a game of musical chairs, a party at the farm with animal friends, and lots of special gifts. Will everything be ready in time for the big day?

programme.title: CoComelon S1E1 -A Fun School Day with JJ & Friends!
programme.desc: Join JJ & his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks & drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses & how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day & enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning & fun!

programme.title: Little Angel S8E1 -A Magical Day of Make-Believe!
programme.desc: Get ready for a magical day of make-believe with Baby John & his family! First, Baby John is dressed in shark pajamas & doesn't want to brush his teeth, so Daddy has to make it a fun game! Then, Baby John & Manny pretend to be rival farmers with outlandish animals like tigers & dinosaurs on their farms. The make-believe continues as Jill gets a new mermaid costume & Mom & Dad dress up as pirates to convince her to finally take it off for a bath!

programme.title: Little Angel S4E3 -Baby John is a Great Big Brother!
programme.desc: Baby John is learning how to be a great big brother & a good friend! When Mom needs a nap, Jack & Jill decide to help by taking care of their little brother. Then, Baby John learns how to be a friend to everyone by sharing, working together & including everyone in play. Baby John also shows he has a great role model, because he loves his big brother Jack & wants to be just like him, following him around & copying everything he does!

programme.title: ARPO S3E2 -The Ultimate Arpo vs Squirrel Showdown!
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo & his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie & tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo & takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: ARPO S2E1 -Squirrel Trouble & Other Wacky Problems!
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble & other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably & when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: Minibods S1E7 -Messy Guest, Cracked, Hoppy & Teddy!
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend & a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer & has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, & when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health & Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: Minibods S1E9 -My Hero, A Story, A Teddy & Greens!
programme.desc: The Minibods are learning about heroes, sharing, honesty & eating greens! When Lulu loses her favorite bunny, Bubbles comes to the rescue & becomes her personal superhero! Then, Jeff is excited to read a new book but refuses to include his friends, so he must learn the joy of sharing a story. The lessons continue as Pogo accidentally ruins Newt's teddy-shaped hedge & learns to tell the truth, & Fuse finds the courage to eat his healthy Oddsprouts!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum S2E4 -A Big Day of Imagination & Play
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of imagination & play with Mia & Max! First, they decide to let their imagination run free & build a big dollhouse, but Max has more fun pretending to be a dinosaur that knocks it down! Then, Daddy & Twinkle show the kids how much fun can be had with shadow puppets, making all sorts of different animal shapes. The imaginative fun continues as they turn five empty green bottles into fuzzy-armed monsters that Twinkle brings to life!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum S3E2 -Sweet Dreams & Goodnight Songs!
programme.desc: Get ready for sweet dreams & goodnight songs! First, Mia giggles with delight as she gathers four of her favorite stuffed animals into bed with her for a fun game of 'Ten in the Bed.' The bedtime fun continues as Maple & Muffin play a game of 'Five Little Monkeys' during their bubble bath. Then, Grandma Panda helps Mia & Bari embark on a fantastic adventure, building a little rocket out of cushions to go on an adventure to the moon!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies S1E1 -Relaxing Sounds for Babies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost!

programme.title: Driving Miss Wealthy
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Sound Supreme Trio of Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: Fish Liew, Jennifer Yu and Peter Chan Charm Man, have been invited to voice over Cantonese version of the animation film “Ne Zha 2”. This episode features these three actors sharing the joys and challenges of the dubbing process. While Fish tells that Cantonese has been a big challenge for her, Jennifer surprisingly wants to gigantify herself when asked which character's magic she would like to acquire and Peter also praises Fish even more! Let's find more fascinating behind-the-scenes stories they are going to share one by one......

programme.title: Ne Zha 2 (Cantonese Dubbed)
programme.desc: Ne Zha returns again joining by versatile stars - Jennifer Yu, Fish Liew and Peter Chan, who bring their unique voices and witty dialogue to the adventures of Ne Zha and Ao Bing and breathe a new life into the story. After the heavenly lightning, although Ne Zha and Ao Bing survived by becoming spirits, they would soon dissipate completely. Taiyi plans to rebuild Ne Zha and Ao Bing's mortal bodies with the Seven-colored Precious Lotus. However, during the process of reconstruction, numerous obstacles arise. Together, they embark on a new journey to challenge their fate.

programme.title: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change!
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins...

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Furious Clash
programme.desc: “The Furious” Director Kenji Tanigaki, Producer Frank Hui and leading actor Xie Miao are invited to share their filming experiences. Frank reveals the best fighter agreed unanimously upon by five martial arts masters in the film. Xie talks about how he used punches to express the character's ruthlessness! Kenji also unveils the hardships behind creating one of the major scenes with 'five-person melee battle' in the film.

programme.title: Somewhere Winter
programme.desc: In front of the venue of CHYI Chin's concert, An tries to get herself a concert ticket while the tickets are sold out. Looking at the frustrated girl, Xiao walks towards the girl and gives her free tickets. It was 1991. After two years, An meets Xiao again. They fall in love with each other. The distance between Taipei and Beijing doesn't stop the lovers. However, under the pressure of Xiao's family, the lovers are separated. Xiao is forced to marry another woman...

programme.title: Ip Man 4 The Finale
programme.desc: Ip Man's life remains unchanged after his wife's death, but he and his son are slowly drifting apart. To seek a better future for his son, Ip Man decides to travel to the U.S. only to find the stable, peaceful life abroad is only skin deep. Underneath lies a deep rooted racial discrimination that is far worse than he has expected. Ip Man re-examines his position and ponders on the reason he took up martial arts in the beginning.

programme.title: Four Loves
programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man...

programme.title: Cops And Robbers
programme.desc: A young man who was addicted to firearms wanted to be admitted to the police. He was not admitted because of his eye disease, which caused him psychological imbalance and he killed people everywhere. The police set up a special unit to arrest him. A fledgling policeman met the murderer on a narrow road...

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: C.N. faces his greatest challenge when he meets young country girl Bu and falls in love! But when Howie sets a trap for him, C.N. must prepare to fight for his lady and his life!

programme.title: The Miracle Fighters
programme.desc: Two elderly Taoist priests, Chi Men and Dun Jia, who learn their magic from the same teacher always quarrel with each other. They provide mirth and expert kung fu tuition to young man who is mistakenly presumed to be the crown prince of the Imperial Court, missing since childhood. The emperor dispatches an eunuch with the magic powers to apprehend the young man. But he must first deal with Chi Men and Dun Jia who are the young man's protector...

programme.title: The Inspector Wears Skirts
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out...

programme.title: Fighting For Love
programme.desc: Tung Choi is the third-generation shop owner of a string of beef noodle restaurants. He gets into a minor fender bender with the hard working, yet outwardly mean Deborah. The two engage in an ill-tempered spat which makes both characters seem completely unlikable. Meeting later to negotiate a truce, the two end up engaging in a one-night stand, but a happy ending is far from possible. Tung is linked to high-maintenance TV personality Mindy, and Deborah is about to encounter a fitting fall from grace. Thanks to her mean-spirited behavior, she loses her job, her home (she and her father have a spat), and possibly her self-respect. Deborah and Tung encounter each other at the hospital, where Tung is visiting his mother and Deborah is staying (as in sleeping on the floor) with her sister. Tung offers to let her freshen up at his home, but she ends up sleeping on the couch for a short period of time. Tung's extremely weird family seems against Deborah; they tout Mindy's positive p

programme.title: Back To Our 1994: Return To A Better Tomorrow
programme.desc: Cool and brave, Tong is the most famous big brother. Ha, a loyal follower of Tong, is charged murdering his unfaithful wife's lover. Fortunately, he is saved by Tong's lawyer...

programme.title: Sea Wolves
programme.desc: As a Philippine freighter moors in Hong Kong, Gary, a man on board, assaults a Customs Officer during a routine inspection and escapes ashore. Then, a series of homicides occur near the pier. The killer's identity and motive remain a mystery until Inspector Yeung is assigned to investigate the case and links it to Gary. Acting on a tip-off that Gary is hiding in a prostitute's home, Yeung tries to trap him, but the polices also arrest the Captain's brother, John...

programme.title: Fighting to Survive
programme.desc: Bon Bon, a resident of Tuen Mun, who's always attempting to implement his latest pyramid scheme. Bon Bon rescues a lady from a lecher occasionally and decides to implement his latest scheme, 'One Dollar Bodyguard'. He'll protect women on their evening strolls for one HK dollar. Bon Bon has to attend to his own problem, which is his inability to ride in a moving vehicle, that strands him in Tuen Mun for life. And there's the romantic issue with Snooker to resolve...

programme.title: Tiger and Crane E7
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: The Truth Within E8
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: Nothing but You E5
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: Master of My Own E27
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: The Truth Within E8
programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

PGA Tour Champions Highlights 2026 -Kaulig Companies Championship
PGA TOUR Champions Learning Center 2026 E13
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E3
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 3 E16
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama) E25
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: Princess Revenge (Mini drama) E1
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: Fantastic Journey Season 3 E3 -深入伊金霍洛旗化身蒙古勇士
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程。

programme.title: A Wonderful Life Starts with Health E66
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E3
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Talk With Famous Doctors E29 -甲狀腺結節
programme.desc: 全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊。

programme.title: Mars Agency Season 7 (Repackaged) E1 -綜藝三神獸首次齊聚
programme.desc: 腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開！

programme.title: Eternal Joy With You (Mini drama) E26
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛、親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生。

programme.title: Princess Revenge (Mini drama) E2
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身。這是一場關於覺醒、反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則。

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 4 E67
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16 E28 -從瘦了70斤到愛情排第三
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: Who's Still Standing Youth Edition E7 -數學天才帶隊踢館速答300題
programme.desc: 百位少年齊聚一堂，智慧與勇氣同時接受考驗，黃聖依、黃子弘凡、龐博、張雨綺、李雪琴、陳銘等嘉賓將一直陪伴，引領他們突破自我；到底誰能突破第一道考驗，順利進入組隊資格賽？誰又將通過豐富知識儲備量「站」到最後？一同見證智慧賽場的巔峰瞬間吧！

programme.title: Perfect Match E45 -高顏值學霸魅力登場
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。
